items.name: freeCodeCamp
items.summary: freeCodeCamp 是一个来自 GitHub 的项目，面向希望快速交付的工程团队。 核心能力围绕 freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free. 展开，突出稳定与易用性。 重点领域涵盖 careers, certification, and community，形成多模态协同能力。 近期指标包括 ⭐ 429932 颗星标、🔀 41950 次派生、🐛 296 个问题。 典型应用场景覆盖 careers, certification, and community 等方向，适合希望快速落地的工程团队。
items.summary_en: freeCodeCamp is a GitHub project that advances applied AI workflows. It focuses on freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.. Key themes include careers, certification, and community. Recent metrics include 429932 stars, 41950 forks, 296 open issues. Typical use cases span careers, certification, and community, making it practical for production teams.
